materials.name: Tachyon 100G
materials.peel_condition: Low profile and very low profile copper foil (4.5 lb/in)
materials.notes: Ultra low loss laminate and prepreg for data rates of 100 Gb/s and beyond, with spread glass and ultra smooth HVLP copper (HVLP3 / VLP1 1.1 um Rz JIS, HVLP / VLP2 2.5 um Rz JIS, embedded resistor foil also offered). IPC-4101/102 and IPC-4103/17; UL file E41625. Time to delamination by TMA with the copper removed: T260 above 60 min, T288 above 60 min, T300 above 20 min; 6 cycles at 260 C reflow and 6 at 288 C solder float. The Dk at 2, 5 and 10 GHz is 3.04, 3.02 and 3.02; the Df table of the sheet keeps only 0.0021 (the headline value, taken as the 10 GHz figure). Peel strength 4.5 lb/in (0.79 N/mm) and 5.5 lb/in (0.96 N/mm) after thermal stress. Dielectric breakdown 60 kV; electric strength 60 kV/mm (1500 V/mil); comparative tracking index class 3 (175-249 V); relative thermal index 130 C; Taylor modulus 2264 and 2197 ksi; Poisson ratio 0.165 and 0.156; resistivities 1.33e7 M-ohm cm and 1.33e5 M-ohm converted. Tg by DSC, DMA and TMA 215, 230 and 210 C.

materials.name: TerraGreen 400GE
materials.peel_condition: Low profile and very low profile copper foil (4.1 lb/in)
materials.notes: Halogen free, ultra low loss laminate and prepreg, the lowest cost member of the TerraGreen 400G family (E-glass, mechanically spread glass; HVLP3 / VLP1 1.1 um Rz, HVLP / VLP2 2.5 um Rz and advanced RTF 2.5 um Rz copper). IPC-4101/134; UL file E41625; FR-4 process compatible, sequential lamination capable, CAF resistant. Td by TGA above 380 C and moisture absorption below 0.1 % (bounds); time to delamination by TMA with the copper removed: T288 and T300 above 60 min; 6 cycles at 260 C reflow and 6 at 288 C solder float. Dk 3.29 at 10 GHz and 3.25 at 20 GHz; the Df table keeps only 0.0026 (10 GHz). Dielectric breakdown 70 kV; electric strength 67 kV/mm (1700 V/mil); comparative tracking index class 2 (250-499 V); relative thermal index 140 C; flexural modulus 12.1 and 11.7 GPa (lengthwise, crosswise); resistivities 2.0e8 M-ohm cm and 2.0e7 M-ohm converted.
